description: Editorial approvals keyed to exact record fingerprints. Empty means no retroactive certifications.

builder/speaker/psb-alpha-p3.reviewer: ChatGPT GPT-6 (AI-assisted manufacturer datasheet source review; no human release sign-off)

evidence.fields: Exact Alpha P3 variant; 1 W (2.83 V), 1 m, IEC-filtered pink noise, C-weighted sensitivity 85 dB anechoic/87 dB typical listening room; nominal 8 Ω, minimum 4 Ω; 80 W recommended amplifier maximum and 60 W program input power; passive binding posts.
Original model/marketing product page and manufacturer-stated recommended amplification; not a continuous clean SPL or power-handling measurement.

builder/speaker/psb-alpha-p3.decisionNote: Source-field review only: approve manufacturer 1 W (2.83 V) anechoic sensitivity reference and 8 Ω nominal/4 Ω minimum exactly as stated for the named Alpha model. Program power is not continuous damage threshold, 87/89 dB in-room is not assumed measured in visitor room, and compatibility, distortion-limited headroom and safe loudness of any amp/speaker pairing require separate checks. AI-reviewed, not independently bench-measured or human deployment-approved.
